title.zh: 【印度执法局调查约 5.25 亿美元加密货币跨境交易，涉及 Mudrex 和 Instadapp】
title.en: 【印度执法局调查约 5.25 亿美元加密货币跨境交易，涉及 Mudrex 和 Instadapp】

current_state.zh: India's Enforcement Directorate searched multiple locations and is investigating roughly $525 million in unauthorised cross-border crypto transfers under FEMA, involving Mudrex, Saber.money and Instadapp (Fluid), with alleged use of USDT/USDC stablecoins, large OTC deals and offshore shell companies to bypass RBI-authorised remittance channels.
